chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhayna, from Ismail ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ فَقَالَ: ائْلَقْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ فَسَلْهُ عَنْهَا فَإِنَّ عِنْدَهُ مِنْهَا عِلْمًا، فَلَقِيتُهُ فَأَمْلَى عَلَيَّ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا كَثِيرًا فِي اسْتِحْلَالِهَا … فَأَتَيْتُ بِالْكِتَابِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَعَرَضْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: صَدَقَ وَأَقَرَّ بِهِ

translations.en: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about Mut'ah, so he said: Go and meet Abd al-Malik ibn Jurayj and ask him about it, for he has knowledge of it. So I met him and he dictated to me a great deal from it regarding its permissibility… Then I came with the book to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and presented it to him, so he said: He is truthful, and he affirmed it.

en.summary: This hadith highlights the Shia practice of validating religious rulings through non-Shia experts (ahl al-kutub), specifically Abd al-Malik ibn Jurayj, whose detailed account of Mut'ah al-Hajj was verified by Imam al-Sadiq. It underscores the scholarly tradition of cross-referencing with diverse sources to establish the authenticity of legal permissibility, affirming that the Imam’s approval serves as the ultimate seal of truth for the transmitted knowledge.
en.seo_question: What is the Shia scholarly view on the permissibility of Mut'ah based on the narration of Ibn Jurayj?

key_terms.عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ: Abd al-Malik ibn Jurayj (a prominent non-Shia scholar)
